name: Port Logistics Hub - Berth 12
mission_theme: Container port: repeated payload transfers between quay and yard with cranes blocking line of sight.

task_generation.rule: tasks are instantiated from the 10 task templates with scenario-specific parameters; composite tasks add contingency patterns that combine two templates

tasks.title: Payload delivery to DZ-BERTH-12 (2.0 kg, +/-3 m)
tasks.brief: Deliver 2.0 kg from PICKUP-DEPOT to DZ-BERTH-12 before t = 420 s. Release from at least 15 m so the payload is not damaged; the landing point must be within 3 m of the drop-zone centre and the impact speed below 3 m/s. One teammate may carry the payload while the other screens the corridor. Recover to LZ-BERTH afterwards.
tasks.objective: Move 2.0 kg from PICKUP-DEPOT to DZ-BERTH-12 and release it so that the impact point is within 3 m of the drop-zone centre, with an impact speed below 3 m/s.

actions: choose the delivery UAV and the escort role
pick a route that avoids no-fly zones
align within 3 m of the centre
climb clear of the drop area

constraints: single payload per task
no release over a no-fly zone
escort UAV keeps >= 20 m from the carrier
failure_conditions: payload released above 25 m
payload damage flag raised
delivery after the task window closes

tasks.title: Point inspection of POI-CRANE-1 (20 m standoff, 4 images)
tasks.brief: Inspect POI-CRANE-1. Hold a standoff of 20 m (tolerance 3 m) at 45 m AGL, aim the gimbal 30 deg down and take at least 4 images per face. Hover at least 8 s at each capture point so the image is stable. Do not enter the 10 m keep-out radius around POI-CRANE-1 and keep 25 m from your teammate.

check image count and pitch per angle
re-capture any angle short of 4 images

constraints: hover only at declared capture points
no flight below 45 m in the inspection ring

tasks.title: Coverage survey of BLOCK-QUAY (90% target, 2 UAVs)
tasks.brief: Your team must survey the block BLOCK-QUAY completely. Fly parallel tracks at 70 m AGL with 20 % side overlap and keep every UAV 15 m apart. The survey is accepted only when the reported coverage of the block is at least 90 %. Recover to LZ-BERTH when the coverage target is met or the task window closes.
tasks.objective: Fly a complete parallel-track survey of BLOCK-QUAY with 2 UAVs at 70 m AGL and deliver a coverage record that reaches at least 90 % of the block with 20 % side overlap between adjacent tracks.

actions: assign one strip set per UAV
mission_phases.output: track plan with strip ids and entry points

actions: form a safe line before entering the block
re-fly any strip that reports a gap
declare complete or request a re-fly

constraints: minimum separation 15 m at all times
single sortie per UAV for this task
no manual pilot override
failure_conditions: any UAV leaves the geofence
any UAV enters a no-fly zone
coverage below 60% when the task window closes
loss-of-control or collision flag

checkpoints.name: Team launch
checkpoints.metric: elapsed time from task start to last UAV inside BLOCK-QUAY

checkpoints.name: Track discipline
checkpoints.metric: cross-track error per strip and side overlap between adjacent strips

checkpoints.name: Coverage target
checkpoints.metric: union coverage of BLOCK-QUAY at the recorded altitude

checkpoints.name: Airspace integrity
checkpoints.metric: time outside geofence and inside no-fly zones
checkpoints.target: 0 s outside geofence, 0 s inside any no-fly zone

checkpoints.name: Recovery
checkpoints.metric: landing separation and hard-landing flag
checkpoints.target: all UAVs on ground at LZ-BERTH, separation >= 10 m, no hard landing

tasks.title: Formation transit through CORRIDOR-QUAY (line, 25 m spacing)

params.emcon_target: link held, >= 1 status report per 60 s

tasks.brief: Fly from WP-ENTRY-E to WP-EXIT-W through CORRIDOR-QUAY in a line formation with 25 m spacing. Assemble the formation before the corridor entry; inside the corridor there are obstacle edges within 70 m. Keep formation error small, never trigger a separation warning, and complete the transit within 360 s.

build the line formation with 25 m spacing
fly the corridor at constant speed

no re-planning that changes slot order mid-corridor
failure_conditions: corridor obstacle strike
formation broken for more than 30 s

tasks.title: Perimeter patrol and intrusion response at PERIM-YARD (sector S2)
tasks.brief: Patrol the closed perimeter PERIM-YARD at 70 m, one UAV per assigned sector, and log a complete loop every 240 s. An intruder will enter from sector S2; detect it within 60 s, identify it (hover >= 5 s within 60 m) and shadow it while it stays within 250 m of the perimeter. Do not leave the geofence while chasing.
tasks.objective: Keep a continuous patrol of PERIM-YARD at 70 m, detect an intrusion entering at sector S2 within 60 s, identify it positively and shadow it inside 250 m of the perimeter.

actions: assign one UAV per sector with overlap
hand the track to the nearest UAV

constraints: minimum altitude 70 m - 20 m
no pursuit outside 250 m
failure_conditions: perimeter left uncovered for more than 120 s
geofence breach during the pursuit
intruder never detected

checkpoints.name: Patrol continuity
checkpoints.metric: perimeter length covered per loop and loop period
checkpoints.target: >= 90% of the perimeter each loop, period <= 240 s

checkpoints.name: Detection latency
checkpoints.metric: time from intrusion to first detection report

checkpoints.name: Positive identification
checkpoints.metric: hover time within 60 m of the intruder
checkpoints.target: >= 5 s hover and ID record submitted

checkpoints.name: Shadowing
checkpoints.metric: intruder distance from the perimeter while shadowed
checkpoints.target: intruder never beyond 250 m unshadowed for > 20 s

checkpoints.name: Patrol resume
checkpoints.metric: time to restore the abandoned sector

tasks.grading: global checkpoint pass rate; each checkpoint is scored independently and weighted

tasks.title: Relay chain between GS-BASE and GS-BERTH (2 hops, 6 min)
tasks.brief: Link GS-BASE and GS-BERTH, which are 2700 m apart and cannot see each other. Fly a relay chain of 2 UAVs at 100 m AGL, keep the end-to-end link above -88 dBm for 6 min, and rebuild the chain within 45 s if a relay drops. No UAV may hover closer than 90 m to another.

assign one altitude per relay to reduce interference
fly to the slots at 100 m
replace a lost relay within 45 s

constraints: relay altitude >= 100 m - 20 m
no relay outside the geofence
failure_conditions: link down for more than 60 s in total
relay chain not established by t = 300 s
both relays hovering at the same slot

If the relay drops below the required link quality, the transit must pause until it is restored.

constraints: relay orbit radius <= 200 m

tasks.title: Mission continuity after losing UAV-2 and UAV-4 at t=420 s
tasks.brief: At about t = 420 s, UAV-2 and UAV-4 are lost (link and telemetry gone). The mission still needs at least 55 % of the BLOCK-QUAY work done. Re-plan the surviving fleet, protect the critical core of the plan, and declare what is dropped and why. Do not launch a search for the lost UAVs.
tasks.objective: Keep the mission-critical core of BLOCK-QUAY running after UAV-2 and UAV-4 are lost at t = 420 s, delivering at least 55 % of the original plan with the surviving UAVs.

actions: detect the loss of UAV-2 and UAV-4
report dropped work and residual risk

constraints: surviving UAVs may not leave the geofence
no new tasks after t = 900 s
failure_conditions: abandoning the critical core
searching for lost UAVs
no statement within 180 s
